stories.title: Share Task via Public Link
stories.body: As a registered user, I want to share a task with others by generating a public link, so that external collaborators can view the task without needing an account.
acceptance_criteria: Given a logged-in user owns a task, when they request a public share link, then a unique URL must be generated for that task.
Given a public share link exists, when anyone accesses it, then they can view the task details without authentication.
Given a public share link, when an unauthenticated user accesses it, then they must only see the specific task it was generated for and no other tasks.
